messages:
dina: Quick PSA  Judah at 48th is a surprise pond right now. Light rail is crawling. I just watched a toddler splashway into the city. 20m delays from what transit app says. :umbrella: 
leo: Oh man. Is this the same spot that turns into a kiddie pool after a drizzle? 
transit-bot: TransitBot: N-Judah: significant slowdown near 48th Ave due to standing water on tracks. Estimated delay: 15-25 minutes. Shuttle service may be added. BART/Caltrain unaffected. 
sam: Switched to Muni express shuttle. Took an extra 12 minutes but dry socks = win. 
dina: also FYI 46th St crosswalk fountain is back (why does that happen every season?) Avoid the east curb if you're walking. 
anya: Poll for the soggy-commuters: React with :socks: if you changed footwear, :bus: if you took a bus/shuttle, :uber: if you gave up and cabbed it, :coffee: if you stayed home. 
jeff: :socks: new dry socks in my bag, hero move. 
sam: :bus: shuttle mode. 
leo: :coffee: delayed start, making it a remote morning. 
dina: Also anyone with a spare waterproof laptop sleeve? Mine is in the dryer (don't ask). Happy to trade pastry for sleeve borrow. 
anya: There's a little rack of emergency ponchos at reception now (thanks facilities). 
transit-bot: TransitBot: City crew clearing drains near 48th/Judah. Expect gradual improvement in ~30-45 minutes. Updates: https://traffic.example/ (mock) 
jeff: Pro tip: if you commute by bike, avoid the gutter lane near the market - it's turned into a reflective pool and will spray you. 
sam: Note for later shifts: the 46th/47th underpass has a low spot; might be darker and deeper than it looks. Walk around if possible. 
dina: Thanks for the heads up. Heading in via Irving instead. If anyone wants the pastry trade, ping me. :croissant:
